title: Muraja'ah: 'Abasa and An-Nazi'at 1 to 8 with madd: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 22 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Muraja'ah rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 22. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرْقًۭا (١) وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشْطًۭا (٢) وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبْحًۭا (٣) فَٱلسَّٰبِقَٰتِ سَبْقًۭا (٤) فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًۭا (٥) يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ (٦) تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ (٧) قُلُوبٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاجِفَةٌ (٨)

keywords.def: older surahs revised on a rota

questions.q: Chain recitation: each pupil recites one ayah of 79:1-8 in register order.
questions.a: 79:1-8 recited in order by the class.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 79:1-8 and one older surah to the teacher. Everyone else: 3-3-link the weakest ayat, then log revision.
questions.a: Rubric marked with one target for each pupil.

questions.q: Extend: write your own target from today's feedback in the portal response box. Start: 'Next time I will ...'
questions.a: For example: 'Next time I will hold the madd lazim in ٱلطَّآمَّةُ for six counts.'

questions.q: Madd 'iwad at a stop on «غَرْقًۭا» is ...
Think again: You learned 'Abasa before the break. What does a long break do to hifdh, and how do you win it back?
questions.a: Some ayat slip; daily short revision and reciting to someone brings them back fastest.
